# Simple Form — Refinement Punch-List

_Triaged from a 7-dimension refinement audit. Findings deduped and verified against source. This is a triage doc — no issues filed. Severity · Effort where effort is S/M/L._

## Quick wins (high-value, low-effort — do these first)

- [ ] (high · S) i18n-wrap CP nav labels — `Plugin.php:311,314,317` — wrap `'Forms'`/`'Submissions'`/`'Settings'` in `Craft::t('simple-form', …)` (verified unwrapped).
- [ ] (high · S) i18n-wrap permission labels — `helpers/SimpleFormPermissions.php:22–34` — wrap all 5 label strings in `Craft::t('simple-form', …)` (verified unwrapped).

- [ ] (medium · M) Form-builder dynamic controls have no focus management — `forms/edit.html:613–684` — on add/remove move focus to a stable anchor; add `aria-live="polite"` to the list.

- [ ] (low · S) Asset-registration failure falls back to inline assets too quietly — `TwigExtension.php:185–192` — raise log severity / surface in devMode.

## Themes

The audit's signal concentrates in three places. First, **i18n is the highest-yield cluster**: nav labels, permission labels, controller flash messages, and an entire field-builder JS string set ship untranslated, and the translation catalog has drifted (stale MCP scope copy, missing de/fr/es/it parity) — these are almost all low-effort, high-impact wins. Second, **the CP has drifted from Craft conventions through hand-rolled markup**: inline `<style>`/`<script>` blocks, custom tables and pagination, a bespoke settings sidebar, non-Craft status-badge colors, and a confirmed dead `submissions/list.html` that diverges from the shipped `index.html` — consolidating into a CP asset bundle + Craft helpers pays down most of this debt at once. Third, **feedback and accessibility share the same root weakness — JavaScript bolted onto the markup without the surrounding contract**: silent AJAX failures, inconsistent error-response shapes, native `alert()`/`confirm()`, a non-focusable delete control, missing input `id`s, and absent `aria-invalid`/focus management. Underlying all of it is a discoverability gap around the Integrations feature, which has no breadcrumbs and no top-level entry point. Start with the Quick wins (mostly i18n + the two genuine a11y/feedback bugs), then tackle the CP-consolidation and Integrations-IA items as the larger structural follow-ups.

## Triage notes (from the prioritizer)

All key claims verified. The integration delete is an `<a>` with `role="button"` but no `href` (genuine a11y bug — not keyboard-focusable/activatable). The AJAX `onload` only handles `status===200` + `r.success`, with no `onerror` (genuine silent-failure). Radio/checkbox inputs lack `id`. I have enough to triage confidently.

Notable dedup decisions: the inline-CSS findings (nav-ia #9, cp-consistency "Inline CSS blocks", "Status badge colors", a11y "Status badges color alone") overlap heavily and collapse into a small cluster. The breadcrumb findings (nav-ia integrations breadcrumb + forms edit breadcrumb) merge. The i18n catalog findings (missing en entries + de/fr/es/it parity) merge. The error-response-shape findings (FieldsController keys + IntegrationsController vs SubmissionsController shapes) merge. `list.html` is confirmed dead code, which reframes the "dual templates" finding.
